title: Towards Training Transformers as a Universal Computer
abstract: arXiv:2604.25166v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We demonstrate that a small transformer can learn to execute programs in MicroPy, a simplified yet computationally universal programming language. Given procedure definitions together with an expression to evaluate, the transformer predicts small-step execution using PENCIL scaffolding for space-efficient execution within a bounded context window. After training on randomly generated, semantically arbitrary MicroPy programs, the learned transformer generalizes to held-out human-written programs including bit copying and flipping, binary addition and multiplication, and SAT verification and solving. The trained model exhibits out-of-distribution generalization: it correctly evaluates programs drawn from a substantially different distribution than the one used to generate its training data. Since MicroPy can express any computation, our results provide empirical evidence that a standard transformer can be trained to act as a universal

translated_title: 迈向将Transformer训练为通用计算机
translated_abstract: 我们证明了一个小型Transformer可以学会执行MicroPy程序，MicroPy是一种简化但具有计算通用性的编程语言。给定过程定义和待求值的表达式，Transformer使用PENCIL脚手架来预测小步执行，从而在有界的上下文窗口内实现空间高效的执行。在随机生成的、语义任意的MicroPy程序上进行训练后，学习到的Transformer能够泛化到未见过的由人类编写的程序，包括位复制和翻转、二进制加法和乘法，以及SAT验证和求解。训练后的模型展现出分布外泛化能力：它能够正确求值来自与训练数据生成分布截然不同的分布的程序。由于MicroPy可以表达任何计算，我们的结果提供了经验证据，表明标准的Transformer可以被训练为通用计算机。
tldr: 一个小型Transformer通过在随机生成的计算通用语言MicroPy程序上训练，能够执行人类编写的各类程序并展现出分布外泛化能力，为标准Transformer可被训练为通用计算机提供了实证证据。
en_tdlr: A small transformer trained on randomly generated MicroPy programs (a computationally universal language) can execute human-written programs with out-of-distribution generalization, providing empirical evidence that standard transformers can be trained to act as universal computers.
